jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: As a Large Enterprise Account Manager based in Singapore, you will manage and grow PayPal’s portfolio of digital goods and gaming merchants. Focused on the back book, you will protect and expand recurring revenue by strengthening relationships, increasing payment volume and product adoption, maintaining operational rigor, and identifying opportunities across the gaming ecosystem. You will act as a trusted payments advisor to digital goods & gaming merchants, platforms and strategic partners, developing a clear understanding of their commercial priorities, player journeys and payment challenges. Working with Product, Marketing, Risk, Legal, Finance, Operations and regional teams, you will resolve issues and identify opportunities for retention, expansion, cross-sell and upsell. You will bring payments experience, gaming or digital commerce knowledge, commercial judgement and the ability to engage senior stakeholders, manage complex accounts and deliver sustainable revenue growth. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Lead and manage complex projects with diverse scope. Resolve complex issues using expert knowledge. Drive global process improvements and efficiencies. Collaborate with teams to implement best practices. Monitor and enhance business performance metrics. Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Proven experience managing and growing large enterprise or strategic accounts in payments, fintech, financial services or technology. Experience working with gaming, digital entertainment, streaming digital goods/content, marketplaces or other high-volume online businesses. Strong understanding of payment flows and performance measures, including authorisation, conversion, acceptance, settlement, payouts, fraud and chargebacks. Demonstrated ability to retain and expand an existing customer portfolio through consultative selling, negotiation and commercial problem-solving. Experience engaging, influencing and negotiating with senior executives Effective collaboration with cross functional internal teams spanning merchant, product, finance, risk and technology functions. Strong understanding of the Singapore and broader APAC payments landscape. Experience developing account strategies, managing sales pipelines and delivering measurable revenue outcomes. Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across regional and global teams in a matrixed organisation. Highly organised, commercially analytical and able to manage multiple priorities independently. Fluency in English and Mandarin is required to manage customer relationships across Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and markets. 회사 소개
CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS 는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC 는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC 는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS 는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 "쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS 와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
Automation Maintenance 팀은 물류센터 내에 구축된 다양한 자동화 설비를 직접 운영·관리하며 안정적인 센터 운영을 지원하는 조직입니다. 상품 분류 설비인 소터(Sorter), 무인 이동 로봇인 자동 유도 차량(Automated Guided Vehicle)과 자율 이동 로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot), 자동 라벨링 및 패키징 설비, 로봇 암, 컨베이어 등 핵심 자동화 장비의 유지보수와 성능 관리를 담당합니다. 또한 신규 자동화 설비 도입과 지속적인 개선 활동을 통해 현장 근로자의 작업 효율을 높이고 생산성을 극대화합니다. 이를 통해 물류 운영의 안정성과 품질을 강화하며, 쿠팡의 핵심 가치인 고객 만족 실현에 기여합니다.
업무 내용
물류센터 내 자동화 설비의 유지보수 및 예방보전 활동 수행
- 설비 예시: 컨베이어, 자동 분류기(오토소터), 자동 저장 시스템(OSR) 등
주요 설비 운영 지표 분석 및 관리
- 예시: MTBF(고장 간 평균 시간), MTTR(평균 수리 시간) 등
교대조 관리 및 조원 교육 진행
스페어 파츠 등 부품의 적정 재고 수준 관리
자격
요건

설비 보전 경험 보유자

우대
사항

기계/전기 관련 기능사 이상의 자격증을 보유하신 분
PLC 로직/Inverter Parameter 수정 또는 HMI 작화 및 수정이 가능하신 분
기구부 국산화 이상의 개선 경험을 보유하신 분
스페어 파츠 관리 경험을 보유하신 분
설비 셋업(Set-up) 경험을 보유하신 분
근무 위치
안성3 FC : 경기도 안성시 죽산면 녹배길 35
전형 절차 및 안내 사항
전형 절차
서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
참고 사항
본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.
개인정보 처리방침
쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.
https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy

고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률
』
제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.

recruitingops@coupangfs.com
) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

Behind that physical footprint is a large and growing software estate, and that is where our team lives. We build the systems that plan, price, and orchestrate this infrastructure at scale, solving problems with thousands of variables, and we're looking for talented software engineers who want to help. You'll join a team of software engineers building large-scale distributed systems, data pipelines, and ML- and agentic-powered automation, working alongside product, finance, and supply chain partners across AWS. You'll help deliver the highest standards for reliability and security while giving the business the tools to provide seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Come build with the AWS Supply Chain team and create software that lets AWS grow rapidly and stay the pioneer and recognized leader in cloud computing, with direct and immediate impact on the hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world who rely on AWS every day. Supply Chain Management (SCM) systems are at the heart of ensuring we provide our customers with the right computing capacity, in the right region, at the right time. Our team owns the pricing, quoting, and sourcing systems that determine what AWS pays for the hardware that builds the cloud. We build the platforms that generate and validate vendor quotes, drive competitive sourcing and negotiation, and give Finance and procurement teams the cost visibility they need to plan and control a multi-billion-dollar hardware supply chain. Our systems span dynamic quote generation, vendor-facing portals, sourcing and RFQ workflows, and the data pipelines that feed cost estimation and reporting across the org. We are investing heavily in bringing machine learning and agentic automation into this space, using models to estimate hardware costs ahead of vendor quotes so we can unblock planning and budgeting earlier, and building LLM-powered agentic workflows that automate the manual, judgment-heavy steps in quoting, sourcing, and vendor operations. This is a chance to apply modern ML and GenAI to a domain where a better estimate or a faster workflow translates directly into billions of dollars of capital efficiency. As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the team, you will guide your team through the design, development, testing, and deployment of a range of products spanning large-scale distributed backend services, data pipelines, ML-driven cost estimation, and agentic automation. You will help build the technical roadmap, raise the engineering bar, and develop the engineers around you. You will have sound technical acumen, excellent project-management skills, and strong communication skills. You are a true owner, deeply interested in product design, who innovates on behalf of our customers. We have a very flat team structure and offer a unique opportunity for technical leaders who want to work closely with the business to define, design, build, and operate products used across AWS. Key job responsibilities 1. Design, implement, and deploy large-scale, secure, low-latency services and data pipelines that power pricing, quoting, sourcing, and cost estimation for AWS hardware 2. Lead the development of ML and statistical models for cost estimation and forecasting, and drive them from prototype to production with the right accuracy, monitoring, and business guardrails 3. Build agentic and LLM-powered workflows that automate manual steps in quoting, sourcing, and vendor operations, including evaluation and quality controls for non-deterministic systems 4. Functionally decompose complex, ambiguous supply-chain problems into simple, straightforward solutions, and understand system interdependencies and limitations 5. Partner with Finance, procurement, and vendor-facing teams to translate business problems into technical solutions, and drive measurable impact 6. Share knowledge in performance, scalability, system architecture, ML/GenAI practices, and engineering best practices, and mentor engineers across the team A day in the life No two days look the same. You might spend the morning in a design review shaping how a new cost-estimation service fits into our platform, the afternoon deep in implementation or pairing with a teammate on a hard problem, and part of the day bringing machine learning or an agentic workflow into a process that used to be manual. Along the way you'll review code, partner with Finance and procurement to sharpen requirements, help keep the services you own healthy, and mentor the engineers around you. It's a builder's role with real ownership and direct line of sight to the business impact of what you ship. About the team Our team sits within AWS Infrastructure Services Supply Chain Management, close to the money and the decisions. We own the pricing, quoting, and sourcing systems that determine what AWS pays for cloud hardware, and we are actively replacing manual, judgment-heavy processes with ML-driven cost estimation and agentic automation. We are a flat, high-ownership software engineering team that partners daily with Finance, procurement, and vendor-facing teams. We value technical excellence, thoughtful collaboration, and getting the details right, because a single cost estimate can drive billions of dollars of planning. Engineers here get to define a new technical direction, and we are looking for people who want to grow alongside us.

jobs.description: At Amazon, we are committed to ensuring our partners provide safe, healthy, and dignified living conditions for their workers, and we work with them to deliver continuous improvements and effective compliance programs. As our third-party operations continue to evolve across the UAE, we are seeking dedicated Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Coordinators to support our vendor accommodation audit program and protect the welfare of workers housed in vendor-managed facilities. The ideal candidate will apply Amazon's accommodation compliance standards in practice, lead site-level assessments to drive safety and welfare improvements, and support management's efforts to ensure compliance with all program expectations and applicable regulations. With a proactive and detail-oriented approach, you will help drive a culture of accountability by conducting regular audits, managing compliance metrics, and providing guidance on safety and welfare-related processes across our third-party vendor network. You will play a crucial advisory role for vendors and internal stakeholders, helping investigate non-compliances, escalate critical findings, and implement corrective measures that protect worker welfare. In this role, you will report to the WHS Manager, Amazon Operations. Your responsibilities will evolve with the program and may include, but are not limited to, the following. Key Job Responsibilities What you'll do in this role: • Conduct planned and ad-hoc accommodation audits across UAE vendor sites against Amazon's Global Accommodation Compliance Guidance and applicable UAE regulations • Document audit findings, raise escalation tickets for critical findings, and develop Corrective Action Plans in coordination with vendors • Track vendor remediation progress, review compliance evidence, and escalate non-responsive vendors to senior stakeholders • Monitor and analyze compliance metrics, create reports, and identify trends requiring attention The WHS Coordinator will conduct planned and ad-hoc accommodation audits across assigned UAE vendor sites, applying Amazon's Global Accommodation Compliance Guidance and applicable local regulations, including UAE Ministerial Decision 591/2016 for accommodations housing fewer than 50 workers and Cabinet Resolution No. 13 of 2009 for accommodations housing 50 or more workers. Audits will assess compliance across all relevant categories, including structural safety, minimum physical standards, health and safety provisions, fire safety, sanitation, dining, recreational areas, freedom of movement, and worker welfare. The coordinator will document all audit findings accurately in Amazon's internal systems, raise escalation tickets to the relevant remediation teams for critical, alert, and major findings, and develop Corrective Action Plans in coordination with vendors. The role requires proactive vendor communication to schedule site access, manage approval processes, and track remediation progress against agreed timelines. The coordinator will review vendor-submitted evidence to confirm compliance closure and escalate non-responsive vendors to senior stakeholders as required. The coordinator will support ad-hoc audit requests triggered by safety incidents, new building assessments ahead of peak hiring cycles, worker complaints requiring investigation, and regulatory compliance verification requests. The role also includes monitoring and analyzing compliance metrics, creating reports, and reviewing trends to identify areas requiring attention. As the program matures, the coordinator may take on additional responsibilities aligned with Amazon's broader worker welfare and social responsibility objectives.

Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery. Lead platform presence and engagement strategy at major society meetings and technology-focused conferences; support podium strategy and thought leadership positioning. Competitive Intelligence & Market Dynamics Own the competitive intelligence function for the robotic-assisted knee surgery market; monitor competitive platform launches, software updates, clinical publications, pricing shifts, placement strategies, and market share trends. Lead voice-of-customer research programs focused on technology adoption drivers, workflow satisfaction, switching triggers, and unmet digital needs. Deliver regular market and performance briefings to the Director and senior leadership with clear strategic implications and recommended actions. About the Callaway Energy Center

The Callaway Energy Center is a nuclear facility located in mid-Missouri. The Energy Center has more than 800 employees and contractors working at the facility, and it has established a strong record of safe operation throughout its 30-year operating history. The Energy Center is a highly efficient, low-cost, sustainable source of electricity for Ameren Missouri’s 1.2 million customers.

Our benefits include:

•

Medical coverage on date of hire

•

100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

•

401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

•

Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

•

Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

About The Position

The Engineer provides technical conscience and expertise, equipment ownership, and directly facilitates the safe, reliable, efficient operation of the nuclear power plant. This role supports regulatory compliance, optimization and reliability of equipment, plant changes and modifications, system and equipment performance monitoring, cause analysis and troubleshooting, long‑term asset management, and technical assistance to other departments. The Engineer also maintains a thorough knowledge of plant configuration and design, programs and processes, codes and standards, and operating experience applicable to plant operation and the nuclear industry.

Key responsibilities include:

• Management and ownership of assigned technical Programs, Systems, Components, and Design.
• Ensure compliance with NRC regulations, industry codes/standards, and plant procedures.
• Perform evaluation and causal analysis of equipment and system conditions, deficiencies and failures and determine corrective actions for resolution.
• Trend and monitor system and equipment health and performance, through operational data, visual inspections, and physical plant walkdowns.
• Interface with Operations, Maintenance, Work Management, and regulatory agencies as needed for planning and execution of cost-effective maintenance of assigned Systems or Programs.
• Provide engineering support during outages, emergent issues, and operational events.
• Support Maintenance and Operations in equipment troubleshooting and provide technical expertise for troubleshooting significant events or complex plant problems.
• Review technical specifications and instruction manuals to determine testing and maintenance requirements of safety related equipment.
• Develop and revise engineering documents, design changes, procedures, and technical specifications.
• Perform engineering evaluations and reviews of applicable NRC and INPO documents and review, use, and share Operating Experience.
• Perform calculations, technical analyses, and disposition of Requests for Resolution (RFRs) to include Engineering Evaluations, Material Equivalencies, or Modifications.
• Prepare or review procedures covering the operation, testing, and maintenance of equipment, and provide technical support in the preparation of procedure revisions or temporary changes to procedures.
• Support changes in configuration, design and design basis. Performing or participating in technical design reviews, hazard analyses, and maintenance planning.
• Act as Responsible Engineer or Project Manager of projects or modifications, providing oversight of any outside architect or engineering and service organizations that may be used.
• Assume Emergency Response Organization (ERO) duties in accordance with Callaway Radiological Emergency Response Plan (RERP) including timely response to assigned ERO facilities.

Qualifications

Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited institution is required. Electrical Engineering degree preferred. Engineer-in-Training (EIT) or Professional Engineer (PE) Registration preferred. Previous Nuclear Utility experience preferred.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

Good leadership and decision-making, strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, ability to work in a regulated environment and follow strict procedures, excellent written and verbal communication skills, and human relations skills required. Ability to meet plant access, security screening, and fitness-for-duty required.

Working Conditions

The Engineer typically works a standard day shift in an office and plant environment. Additional hours and/or rotating shifts may be required during refueling outages and emergent plant activities as the needs arise. The Engineer must have the ability to work safely in industrial environments; radiation areas, heights, confined spaces, and be committed to industrial safety, nuclear safety culture and use of human performance tools.

Additional Information

Ameren’s selection process includes a series of interviews and may include a leadership assessment process. Specific details will be provided for qualified candidates.

$72,600.00 - $176,100.00

* This pay range encompasses multiple levels of the role. Career level and compensation depends upon applicant’s credentials.

At Ameren, base salary is one component of a competitive compensation package for employees. Our pay ranges are broad to allow for movement within our organization and to accommodate different skill sets and levels of expertise. We take into consideration a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, and internal equity when determining the base salary offered. jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to build and scale the services/cloud layer of VirtSat, Leo's virtual satellite simulation platform. VirtSat lets developers and automated pipelines across Leo create, provision, and test virtual satellites, ground gateways, customer terminals, and TT&C antennas on demand — replacing scarce physical hardware benches with cloud infrastructure that scales with the constellation. You will own the simulation control plane: the APIs, orchestration workflows, and health systems that turn a single request into a fully provisioned, flight-software-running virtual satellite. Every Leo satellite software release is validated on this platform before launch, which means the availability and latency of the services you own directly set the pace at which the constellation ships software. This is a distributed systems role on a platform with an unusual property: your dependencies are physical. You will build APIs whose correctness depends on certificate provisioning, hardware emulation, radio link simulation, and the flight software itself — and you will make that stack behave like a reliable, self-service service. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities * Own the entity lifecycle APIs — create, provision, power-on, and tear down virtual satellites, gateways, customer terminals, and antennas — and drive them to and past a 99.9% availability bar * Design and evolve the orchestration layer: long-running state machines that coordinate provisioning across distributed dependencies where any step can fail on physics rather than code, and where partial failure must be recoverable rather than restart-from-scratch * Own the service-side plugin framework — the published contract, registration, delegation, and result aggregation that lets subsystem owner teams define their own initialization, health validation, and provisioning logic without our team in the loop * Build the health check aggregation API: a single call that returns per-subsystem health with every failure attributed to the team that owns it, so customers self-diagnose instead of paging an on-call * Build and own continuous canaries that validate the full stack against a pre-production constellation on a fixed schedule, wired so that a failure cuts a ticket and pages automatically with no human in the detection path * Integrate with certificate, identity, and entity-registry services — device identity generation at constellation scale, certificate lifecycle, namespace registration, and the calibration data that makes a virtual entity behave like its physical twin * Drive down provisioning latency, currently measured in minutes at p90, through parallelization, image pre-baking, and eliminating serialized dependencies * Own observability end to end — structured logging, embedded metrics, distributed tracing, and log centralization — with the specific goal that a customer can root-cause a failed run from logs alone without recreating it * Scale the platform for concurrent multi-tenant use: capacity management across bare-metal pools, fleet-wide provisioning throughput, and cost per simulated entity * Partner closely with the virtualization and emulation team that owns the host layer, with subsystem owner teams who build against your plugin contract, and with the test frameworks and release pipelines that are your highest-volume customers A day in the life This role is for a Software Development Engineer who will build new cloud services and APIs that manage customer devices such as applying software updates, telemetry, and self-healing. You will be building low-latency, highly scalable architecture that are critical to getting high quality internet service to customers. About the team You will join the VirtSat Platform team within Leo Developer Experience. The team owns VirtSat end to end — the simulation service control plane, the virtualization host layer, fidelity of the emulated subsystems, and adoption across Leo. This role sits on the services side of that boundary. You will own the simulation service: its public APIs, its provisioning workflows, its plugin framework, its canaries and health checks, and its availability and latency posture. A sibling role owns the bare-metal virtualization layer beneath you; you own the contract between them.

jobs.description: Career Category Strategy and Innovation Job Description Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting What you will do The Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting will help Amgen measure, understand, and improve adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) by supporting the measurement, analysis, and reporting capabilities used to assess product management maturity, team health, and quality of core product practices and artifacts. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Management - Product Operations, this individual contributor role will independently own defined measurement and reporting capabilities within the broader Product Operations strategy. The Digital Product Manager will work with Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, digital product teams, analytics and technology partners to maintain meaningful measures, improve dashboards and reporting, conduct product maturity assessments, and translate quantitative and qualitative data into actionable insights. This role will help distinguish activity and compliance measures from meaningful indicators of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact. The Digital Product Manager will use data, stakeholder feedback, and learning from product teams to improve measurement approaches over time and help the Product Management Hub identify where teams are progressing, where barriers remain, and where additional support or enablement may be needed. Responsibilities DPOM Measurement and Metrics • Manage and improve defined measures for DPOM adoption, product management maturity, team health, product artifact quality, and related Product Management Hub priorities. • Apply established measurement frameworks and maturity dimensions across product teams, product groups, and business functions. • Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to evaluate whether measures provide meaningful signals of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact rather than simply tracking activity or completion. • Identify gaps in metrics, data, instrumentation, or measurement approaches and recommend practical improvements. • Define and document data, instrumentation, and KPI requirements for assigned measurement capabilities in partnership with analytics, technology, and reporting teams. Dashboards, Reporting, and Insights • Build, maintain , and improve dashboards, scorecards, reports, and related measurement tools directly and/or in partnership with analytics, technology, and reporting teams. • Gather, organize, analyze, and interpret DPOM-related data using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Jira Align, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ChatGPT, or similar tools. • Prepare recurring reporting and analyses that support MBRs, QBRs, Product Management Hub reviews, and other operating rhythms. • Translate data, trends, qualitative feedback, and product-team observations into clear findings, risks, and recommendations. • Monitor data quality, reporting consistency, and usability of measurement outputs and work with appropriate partners to resolve issues. Product Management Maturity and Artifact Quality • Conduct and support product management maturity assessments using established DPOM frameworks and assessment approaches. • Evaluate product management practices and artifacts such as roadmaps, OKRs, product charters, product strategies, discovery practices, prioritization approaches, and value measures. • Identify recurring maturity gaps, adoption barriers, product management anti-patterns, and areas where teams may need additional guidance or support. • Partner with Product Management Catalysts to incorporate field-based insights and observations from product-team engagements. • Synthesize assessment findings so they can inform Product Operations priorities, playbook improvements, training, accelerator workshops, coaching, and other enablement activities. Reporting Operations and Continuous Improvement • Support integration of DPOM measurement and reporting into established Product Management Hub and enterprise operating rhythms. • Independently manage assigned reporting processes, analyses, or measurement capabilities and continuously improve their quality, usefulness, and efficiency. • Partner with Product Operations colleagues to connect measurement insights with improvements to DPOM standards, playbooks, tools, training, and adoption approaches. • Gather feedback from product teams, leaders, and reporting users to identify opportunities to improve measurement methods, dashboards, reporting experiences, and decision support. • Identify appropriate opportunities to use AI, automation, and reusable workflows to improve data analysis, artifact assessment, reporting, and insight generation. Cross-Functional Partnership and Product Community Contribution • Build trusted relationships with Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, Digital Product Managers, technology leaders, business partners, analytics and reporting teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders. • Influence product-team partners and leaders through clear communication, preparation, data, and evidence-based recommendations. • Facilitate productive discussions about measurement findings, maturity gaps, reporting needs, data limitations, and improvement opportunities. • Partner with data, analytics, technology, privacy, security, regulatory, and governance specialists when measurement or reporting needs require additional expertise. • Share reusable insights, examples, and feedback that help improve DPOM measurement practices and strengthen the broader product management community. What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Digital Product Manager, Product Operations we seek is a product-minded, analytical problem solver who can independently manage defined measurement and reporting capabilities and turn evidence into practical improvements. Basic Qualifications • 3+ years of experience in Digital Product, Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Operations, Product Analytics, Business Reporting, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or comparable customer- and outcome-focused work. • Demonstrated ownership of a defined product area, capability, or comparable problem space, including the ability to make independent decisions within an established strategy and lead cross-functional delivery and iteration. Preferred Qualifications • Experience in product operations, digital product management, product analytics, business reporting, measurement, digital transformation, or related disciplines. • Experience defining, maintaining , or improving adoption, maturity, performance, effectiveness, or quality measures for product teams, operating models, or transformation efforts. • Understanding of product management practices including product strategy, roadmaps, OKRs, product charters, discovery, prioritization, user and business problem definition, and value measurement. • Experience building or maintaining dashboards, scorecards, reporting mechanisms, or recurring business reporting using Power BI, Tableau, Jira Align, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ChatGPT, or similar platforms. • Ability to combine quantitative data, qualitative feedback, and stakeholder perspectives into clear findings and actionable recommendations. • Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to distinguish activity or compliance metrics from meaningful indicators of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact. • Experience defining data, instrumentation, and KPI needs and partnering with analytics or technology specialists to improve measurement capabilities. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data, findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional audiences. • Ability to work independently within an established strategy, manage assigned priorities, navigate ambiguity, and adapt approaches based on evidence and outcomes. • Experience partnering across product, technology, business, analytics, reporting, or enablement teams in a complex enterprise environment. • Experience in healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries preferred; candidates from high-tech, digital, consulting, or product-led organizations are also encouraged to apply. • Familiarity with AI-native workflows, generative AI, responsible AI principles, and opportunities to use AI and automation to improve product measurement, analysis, and reporting preferred. .
